description: Once upon a time, there was a kingdom in a distant land. In this kingdom, there lived a family of two sisters and their parents. One of the sisters had the gift of magical powers and was able to perform striking miracles. Her sister, however, had no magic. One day, the magical sister revealed to her parents about her powers.
